entities.summary: Babatunde Łukasz Aiyegbusi(Yoruba: Babátúndé Łukasz Aiyégbùsì; born May 26, 1988) is a Polish professional wrestler and former American football player. He currently performs on the independent circuit and occasionally for Major League Wrestling (MLW), where he is a former member of Contra Unit, under the ring name Babathunder. He is best known for his tenure with WWE, where he performed under the ring names Dabba-Kato, Babatunde, and Commander Azeez.
